rows.printed_name: Muhammad Ibn Ibrahim Ibn Uthman Ibn Jubair
rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Item dated July 14, 1997: King Fahd 'today received Chairman of the Shura Council Sheikh Muhammad Ibn Ibrahim Ibn Uthman Ibn Jubair', the Deputy Chairman, the Secretary-General and the members of the newly formed Council, 'who all swore an oath before him'.
rows.locator: Item KING FAHD SWEARS IN NEW SHURA COUNCIL, paragraph 1

rows.text: The same item says King Fahd 'then proceeded to inaugurate the second term of the Council', and that in his speech Sheikh Ibn Jubair reviewed the first term and recalled the King's address at its inauguration.
rows.locator: Item KING FAHD SWEARS IN NEW SHURA COUNCIL, paragraphs 1-2
